item.title: Kandinsky in Vienna: Update
item.description: After having to delay SHTF in depths of winter this year, we can announce it’s set to open FOR REAL THIS TIME in April at the Schauspielhaus in Vienna. We’re also going to be there for a week in October developing some new work in public as part of the Schauspielhaus Hotel Season: https://schauspielhaus.at/

item.title: Trap Street & Dinomania: Buy the scripts
item.description: We’re delighted that our shows Trap Street and Dinomania (which both premiered at New Diorama Theatre in 2018 and 2019 respectively) have now been published by Salamander Street. You can buy them HERE.
